name: Full Smile
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Full Smile generated 121 leads at a $11.43 CPL via Meta, with the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting" accounting for $724.92 of the $1,383.45 total spend. The biggest movement this week is a 47.06% drop in spend alongside a 34.36% improvement in CPL, suggesting the budget pullback is concentrating dollars into more efficient placements rather than hurting lead quality.

performance.verdict: Budget pulled too hard — CPL improved but lead volume near collapse.

findings.text: Spend crashed from ~$65/day avg (Jul 26–Aug 14) to $22/day this week; leads hit 0 on Aug 20 and Aug 22, the worst drought in the 45-day window.
OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due Aug 7) and sync/contact cleanup (due Aug 14) are both unresolved, breaking the August scoreboard lead-to-patient trail.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed Jul 23 — prove-it month is live with no updated reporting baseline or client-facing scoreboard delivered yet.
3-day signal (Aug 20–22): avg spend $18.83/day, avg leads 1.67/day vs prior 3 days (Aug 17–19) avg $30.37/day and avg 5.67 leads/day — confirmed deterioration, not noise.
GHL shows 87 opportunities created vs 121 leads with 0 won and 0 appointments logged — 34 leads have no pipeline record; intake or tagging leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta daily budget to ~$50/day (+~$27/day from current $23), targeting CPL ≤$12 to recover lead volume before August ends.
suggestions.monday_update: Daily Meta spend collapsed to ~$19/day (Aug 20–22 avg), producing just 1.67 leads/day — the worst 3-day stretch in 45 days. Restore budget to $50/day, which was the efficient mid-range window where CPL ran ~$11–12 in early August. Success is confirmed if leads return to 4+/day within 3 days (by Aug 26) without CPL exceeding the 28-day baseline of $11.43. Re-check Aug 26.

suggestions.text: Close GHL intake leak: 34 leads missing pipeline records; fix contact-to-opportunity creation so every lead logs an opportunity and appointment.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day data shows 121 leads generated but only 87 GHL opportunities created and 0 appointments logged — 34 leads are invisible to the client's scoreboard. With August as a prove-it month, every lead must trace to an opportunity and a scheduled appointment. Success is confirmed when opp count matches lead count within a 24-hour lag. Target resolution by Aug 25.

suggestions.text: Watch ig_reach: down 53.62% week-over-week and trending to 64 on Aug 22 — flag if organic reach falls below 60 by Aug 26.
suggestions.monday_update: Instagram reach has dropped from ~370 in late July to 64 on Aug 22, a 53.62% weekly decline.
